correctness.rationale: For uniform one-line permutations conditioned on an ordinary fixed point, deleting and standardizing that entry leaves the other upper records unchanged. It adds one record precisely when the remaining prefix consists of the smallest i−1 labels, in which case the prefix and suffix record counts add and their orders are independent. This yields the conditional PGF. Adjacent subtraction gives (z−1)(n−2i)P_{i−1}P_{n−i−1}/(n−1)!; telescoping gives all the tail gaps with the stated sign, and reflection and central equality include n=2. Summing the gaps gives W1. The zero-extended product coefficients are unimodal by real-rootedness and Newton's inequalities, so the variation of their first difference is twice their maximum. Differentiation at one gives the moments and the four positive sites for n≥5. A separately authored exact replay (branches/2b412c8e-80b8-44e8-87eb-fd6b59489e63/replay.py) checked 313 assertions across 46,232 permutations of sizes 2–8; the finite check supports rather than replaces the proof. Frozen checker inspected, not executed.
